title: Landmark Space Missions
description: Landmark space missions with their agency, launch year, type, and key achievement.

results.name: Sputnik 1
results.achievement: First artificial satellite to orbit Earth.

results.name: Vostok 1
results.achievement: Yuri Gagarin became the first human in space.

results.name: Mercury-Atlas 6 (Friendship 7)
results.achievement: John Glenn became the first American to orbit Earth.

results.name: Luna 9
results.achievement: First soft landing on the Moon.

results.name: Apollo 11
results.achievement: First crewed Moon landing; Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walked on the Moon.

results.name: Apollo 13
results.achievement: Aborted Moon mission; crew survived after an in-flight explosion.

results.name: Pioneer 10
results.achievement: First spacecraft to fly by Jupiter.

results.name: Viking 1
results.achievement: First US spacecraft to land successfully on Mars.

results.name: Voyager 1
results.achievement: Farthest human-made object; first to enter interstellar space.

results.name: Voyager 2
results.achievement: Only spacecraft to fly by all four giant planets.

results.name: STS-1 (Space Shuttle Columbia)
results.achievement: First orbital flight of the reusable Space Shuttle.

results.name: Hubble Space Telescope
results.achievement: Space telescope that transformed observational astronomy.

results.name: Mars Pathfinder
results.achievement: Delivered the first rover, Sojourner, to Mars.

results.name: International Space Station
results.achievement: Largest crewed structure in space; continuously inhabited since 2000.

results.name: Cassini-Huygens
results.achievement: Orbited Saturn and landed the Huygens probe on Titan.

results.name: Mars Exploration Rovers
results.achievement: Spirit and Opportunity found evidence of past water on Mars.

results.name: New Horizons
results.achievement: First spacecraft to fly by Pluto.

results.name: Kepler
results.achievement: Discovered thousands of exoplanets via the transit method.

results.name: Mars Science Laboratory (Curiosity)
results.achievement: Advanced rover assessing Mars' past habitability in Gale Crater.

results.name: Rosetta
results.achievement: First mission to orbit a comet and land a probe on it.

results.name: Juno
results.achievement: Orbiter studying Jupiter's composition, gravity, and magnetic field.

results.name: Chang'e 4
results.achievement: First soft landing on the far side of the Moon.

results.name: James Webb Space Telescope
results.achievement: Most powerful infrared space telescope ever launched.

results.name: Mars 2020 (Perseverance)
results.achievement: Deployed the Ingenuity helicopter and cached samples for future return.

results.name: Artemis 1
results.achievement: First integrated test of the SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft around the Moon.
